zh.title: 项目与开源贡献
zh.subtitle: Agent 工程 · 可恢复执行 · 工具可靠性
zh.project_intro: 面向软件维护长任务中的中断、重复请求与验收失真，开发带持久化状态、资源边界及证据归档的维护运行器。
bullets: 连接 SQLite 检查点与隔离 Git worktree，保留工具进度和失败候选；本机 ext4 上的正常运行与首个检查点 SIGKILL 恢复生成相同参考补丁，写入及缓存复用前拒绝 NFS。
实现任务级文件清单、内容哈希校验的源码定位与受保护原版测试验收；导出前检查 Python 语法，校验补丁、验证日志与反馈，拒绝篡改后的成功缓存。
持久化预留 HTTP 次数与 JSON 字节额度，跨重启和修复轮次共享；新增独立 asyncio/HTTPX2 安装包，4 场 Pydantic AI 假服务控制覆盖工具往返、取消、并发与 SDK 重试。
修复独立会话、双重 fork 验证子进程泄漏及旧监督器误加载；Linux 回收后代后才释放运行锁。完整工程回归 116 项通过、零跳过，新增 8 项异步检查已计入。
zh.project_scope: 恢复使用明确参考计划，未证明模型自主修复。9B ADK CPU 轨迹在 8 次请求后停止，无编辑或验收；GPU 短请求工具往返通过，原样文本检查失败，GPU 维护未启动。历史三仓库 NFS 控制与本机 ext4 结果分列；额度不是 token 或费用。

en.title: Projects and contributions
en.subtitle: Agent engineering / Recoverable execution / Tool reliability
en.project_intro: A software-maintenance runner with durable state, resource limits and reviewable evidence for interrupted tasks, repeated requests and unreliable acceptance.
bullets: Connect SQLite checkpoints and isolated Git worktrees to retain tool progress and failed candidates. On local ext4, normal and first-checkpoint SIGKILL runs produce the same reference patch; reject NFS before writes or cached success.

Add task-scoped file inventory, content-hash-checked source navigation and frozen original-test acceptance. Check Python syntax before export and validate patch, log and feedback hashes before reusing success.

Reserve HTTP attempts and JSON bytes durably across restarts and repair rounds. Ship a standalone asyncio/HTTPX2 wheel; four Pydantic AI fake-service cases cover tools, cancellation, concurrency and SDK retries.

Fix detached and double-forked verifier leaks and stale supervisor loading. Reap Linux descendants before releasing the worker lock. All 116 engineering checks pass with zero skips, including eight new async checks.
en.project_scope: Recovery uses explicit plans, not autonomous repair. The 9B ADK CPU run stops at eight requests without edits or acceptance. GPU tool transport passes but raw text fails; GPU maintenance has not started. Historical NFS controls are separate from ext4 evidence. Request limits are not tokens or money.

contributions.name: OpenHands SDK
contributions.text: Preserve undo history after a failed restoration write. Real permission-fault reproduction and 185 related checks pass.

contributions.name: Google ADK
contributions.text: Handle disappearing files during concurrent artifact deletion while preserving nested artifacts. Python 3.11 / 3.13 each pass the same 2,021 related tests with 26 expected failures.

contributions.name: Semantic Kernel
contributions.text: Release the experimental Python runtime token lock before callbacks. 103 related checks pass and real runtime cancellation completes; 12 existing broader-suite failures remain.

en.paper_text: First author. IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters, vol. 22, 2025. Lightweight object detection in forward-looking sonar imagery.
